mapper.sql: sys95_manual_id AS manual_id, sys95_reg_date::date AS reg_date, sys95_manual_type AS manual_type, f_cdnm('ManualType', sys95_manual_type, sys95_company_id, f_today()) AS manual_type_nm, sys10_file_id AS file_id, sys10_file_nm AS file_nm, sys10_file_ext AS file_ext, sys95_public_yn AS public_yn, sys95_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys95_manual INNER JOIN sys10_file ON sys10_parent_id = sys95_manual_id WHERE sys95_manual_id = #{manualId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys95_manual (sys95_manual_id, sys95_company_id, sys95_reg_date, sys95_manual_type, sys95_public_yn) VALUES (#{manualId}, #{companyId}, f_sysdate(), #{manualType}, 'false')
